reviews.title: DO NOT EVER FLY THIS AIRLINE
reviews.text: The planes are old overbooked and ragged. The staff is uninformed and unorganized. And I have been stranded in this airport for nearly twelve hours past my original departure time with NO EXPLANATION FOR THE DELAY. This is the worst flying experience I have ever had. DO NOT FLY THIS AIRLINE EVEN IF RHE FLIGHTS ARE FREE. I would rather take a boat or rent a raggedy bicycle. PRECISION AIRLINES SHOULD NOT BE FLYING PLANES ANYWHERE!!!
reviews.author: Judge Gino
reviews.route: Dar es Salaam - Kilimanjaro National Park

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Two journeys both late. The most annoying thing is the staff in airport did not give any announcement explaining delay or updates on departure time over an hour after we are meant to depart. Absolutely hopeless and now in danger of missing a connecting flight. If you have any choice don't fly with precision air
reviews.author: Claudine J

reviews.title: Super reliable Airline
reviews.text: I read so many bad reviews about Precision Air and was concerbed when we booked out flight from Zanzibar to Arusha and back but everything went very well! Both flights were on time, luggage arrived, we even had snack and drinks on such a short flight. Service was good and very friendly. Also at bot airports everything went smoothly. WE asked our Safari operator about the Airlines and he recommended Precision Air as he never had problems with them. Well done, Precison Air!
reviews.author: Olga T

reviews.title: The worst airline in Tanzania
reviews.text: The flight takes only 30 minutes, but here I am with a 2 hours flight delay. Again. And you are only told once you ask. Bloody incompetent everyone here.
reviews.author: Mzee

reviews.title: Paid for 2 tickets and never received them
reviews.text: We purchased 2 tickets on April 14, 2023 from Precision Air and haven't received them. I've emailed Precision Air several times and they say it is something I need to clear up with E-Com. E-Com has been cc'd in the correspondence via email and they never respond to my inquiries. I have proof on my credit card that the flights were paid for and have sent it to them along along with the PNR reference number. I'm getting no where after 1 month of following up with Precision Air. Precision Air replies to my emails (sometimes it takes a while), but they put me off to someone else all the time. Beware! We booked online right from their site and not through a 3rd party. Sometimes you don't have an option but to fly a certain airline because of routing. I don't want to dive in and purchase another ticket after what's happened.
reviews.author: Travel wise

reviews.title: A nice experience with Precision Air
reviews.text: We had a smooth journey from Dar Es Salam to Arusha and a week later from Arusha to Zanzibar. Easy email correspondence day before when flight suddenly was scheduled 2 hours later than originally. Easy to buy tickets online. Easy online check-in. Snacks and drinks on board. Family of 5.
reviews.author: Michael Hjort C

reviews.title: Going Above and Beyond unexpectedly
reviews.text: I am giving 5 stars due to an individual's example of pride in her service to the customer. She went the extra mile when she didn't have to. Her name is Gilder Dotto. I see that reviews on this airline are either really good or really bad. In this case, my flight was a short flight from Arusha to Zanzibar. I knew ahead of time that this airline is just a regional flight and had low expectations. I only checked one bag and was fairly confident that I would get my bag since I was taking one direct flight with no transfers. I am 6 foot 2 and the legroom for the seats was bit tight. I ended up switching seats so I could get a row to myself. After about 20 minutes, the flight attendants began serving refreshments. When they got to me, I requested a "cappuccino with a drop of cinnamon" as a joke. We both had a good laugh because it was an outlandish request for this type of short regional flight. If it was an international flight on a bigger plane, then it would be a realistic request. So I am sipping my water, and I forget about the joke. She came back briefly after everyone was served and asked if take milk an sugar in my cappuccino. I thought she was continuing the joke. After about 10 minutes, I am surprised the flight attendant returned with a small coffee cup. I received it and saw it was the best attempt at a cappuccino that could be done with regular coffee and powdered creamer. It had a decent layer of froth. It was not just coffee with cream in it. The taste was great but probably even more so because of how thoughtful she was. I know the airline as a whole is not the most amazing, but that doesn't mean that all the individuals who do their job every day don't care about giving the best customer service. And this is one example of an individual going above the normal. She could have just made a regular coffee with cream, but making it look like a cappuccino was a small gesture that made an impact on my experience. I wanted to make sure she gets recognition. Her name is Gilder Dotto. If anyone meets her on a flight, you are in good hands.
reviews.author: Ron Y

reviews.title: Clowns
reviews.text: Do not fly with this airline. First leg from Zanzibar to Arusha went OK. They sent me a text the day before to say that the flight was delayed by an hour. This was good communication. Unfortunately the same can't be said for the return journey. We arrived at 0800 for the 0905 departure to be told that the flight was delayed by 2 hours due 'operational reasons'. At 1100 the staff came around to tell us that the flight was now cancelled and we would fly on the afternoon service leaving around 1500. 1600 the flight we would be taking lands and bursts a tyre on landing making the aircraft unserviceable. They wouldn't tell anyone this though. I was aware something was wrong as I work in the aviation industry. Eventually they told us that a bus would come in 20 minutes to take us to Kilimanjaro airport where an aircraft was waiting for us. After 90 minutes, the bus finally arrived and took us to Kilimanjaro airport. Here we were told to check in again. The check in guys looked at us as iff we were from another planet - useless. They started hand writing boarding passes. When we eventually boarded after 14.5 hours total delay there were three gentlemen who had been given double seat allocation. These guys were unceremoniously told to get off the plane and take the next one. We finally arrived in Zanzibar at 0100 the next day completely missing out on the relaxed afternoon on the beach we thought we were going to have.
reviews.author: SwedenKangaroo

reviews.title: Dar to Arusha via ZNZ
reviews.text: I travelled from Dar es Salaam to Arusha via Zanzibar early this month. Prompt in timing, comfortable seats, no meal in the first flight because it is all 15 minutes, light snacks in the second flight from ZNZ to Arusha. Good experience. Had to wait our bags outside Arusha Domestic Airport for about 10 minutes. Pleasant staff.
reviews.author: Haytham Abu Firas

reviews.title: "You are why we fly....but we don't give a damn about your baggage!"
reviews.text: Even one star is too much! This has got to be the world's worst airline! If you want to arrive at your destination with your baggage, ensure it fits in the cabin with you or choose another airline! Two flight in one week saw first, 15 passengers without luggage even after we saw it next to the plane on boarding and on a second flight it was announced that no luggage would be carried at all, for any of the passengers! What?! Absolutely useless customer service who don't respond even if you complain. AVOID!!!
reviews.author: Nicci M

reviews.title: Horrible Horrible experience
reviews.text: The service is so bad its actually a zero if i really had to rate it.Why is this airline even still operating? I called costumer service about 7 times and the one time the costumer service lady picked up she hang up on me. The delays are horrendous.The government seriously needs to shut Precision air . Dont fly this airline if you want to keep your sanity!!!
reviews.author: the girl
reviews.route: Dar es Salaam - Kilimanjaro National Park

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: We arrived 1,5 hours in advance to the airport in Arusha. The recommended time is 1 hour. After queueing for 20 minutes to the check in desk they told us that the flight was overbooked. There were about 10 other people who got the same message. After demanding the staff for answers on how this was possible, they suddenly changed the story and said that our flight was cancelled, which was a complete lie, since people we knew left on that same flight. Same thing happened to many other passengers on other flights which we could witness while waiting for the staff to give us answers and rearrange our flights. They seem to overbook every flight with up to 5-10 passengers depending on the size of the plane. After several hours of waiting, with very little information about 20 people were taken by bus to Kilimanjaro airport for a chartered flight to Zanzibar and Dar es Salaam This flight was delayed for another three hours. The staff at the Precision Air desk had again no information to give us regarding why the flight was delayed or even which airline we would be flying with. When we finally arrived in Zanzibar some of the passengers luggage was missing. We arrived at our hotel around midnight having missed almost one whole day in our vacation destination. I would never fly PA again.
reviews.author: Lee-Ann

reviews.title: Abandoned luggage
reviews.text: Yesterday we flew from Nairobi to Zanzibar. After clearing immigration we noticed a big queue at lost baggage and informed that AirPrecision had only accepted a few pieces of luggage aboard the aircraft but had left 80% back in Nairobi. We were promised the luggage at 11am the following morning. I awoke at 7am and looked at my apple tracking App to see it was indeed in the airport in Zanzibar. Between 11 and 12 I asked the receptionist at our hotel to look into it for us. She was promised it was on its way. Seven hours later and we are still in our travelling clothes and no luggage! I would on no circumstances recommend that anyone travels with this uncaring airline!!!
reviews.author: Rebecca A

reviews.title: Disgustingly poor customer service upon flight cancellation
reviews.text: The flight got canceled, but the company did not issue the information publicly, so all of us trying to reschedule through 3rd party companies got replies we must have missed the flight as the flight was confirmed. The whole process took around 2 hours and a half. After that, they moved us out of the boarding area, and back to the check-in area, to manage the re-issuance of the tickets, pity there was no way to buy water. 25+ people left waiting for more than 3 hours with no water. We asked over and over again to get water, being promised every single time water would come soon, but it never did until 3 hours later. After 6 to 8 hours we got slowly all rescheduled for the day after, at different times depending on the destination. In the meantime, they kept all checked-in luggage hostage to avoid anyone getting to any hotel. In the meantime, food wasn't even an option, and when finally after several complaints. Finally, at 11 pm we finally get to choose from a menu a sandwich. A sandwich. Finally, and then the time of fixing hotel rooms came...They kept us waiting and waiting beyond midnight just to pay the hotels by the hour and minimize costs. This company is a joke, and unless they don't change something, they will likely end up broke.
reviews.author: dave91itzh

reviews.title: Delays and no communication
reviews.text: Don't book with precision air, this was meant to be a 20 min flight and we were waiting hours. The communication about this was very poor and the staff seemed uninterested/unwilling to help. Book with someone else.
reviews.author: Emel Y

reviews.title: Wild Goose Chases and Broken Promises
reviews.text: I don't suppose another s**t review in the long list that already exist will make any difference.... But it would be incredibly useful if someone from the Customer Service Team would respond. I know TripAdvisor can be a place for bashings and beratings. But really, if you read the reviews and still choose to fly with precision airlines. Be it at your own risk. Delay, delay, delay, cancel, overbooked. No suitable options or alternatives provided, no refunds, vouchers, compensation for time or additional expense offered. Only false promises. And now, no communication. In the end, when we took finding a solution into our own hands, we were promised that someone would meet us off the plane. Alas, and within expectations that never happened. There is little use in getting angry towards the people you might meet. Some kinda try, and I don't envy their jobs. This airline is systematically floored. And greedy. The issues are endless and the staff available are just a protective layer to anyone trying to hide. What's more, for flight's that they know are already overbooked, they continue to sell expensive tickets. We know this because they couldn't find us an alternative flight for this reason, whilst tickets remain on sale. They collect 150usd, claim the flight is over booked and offer an 60usd airport hotel. So taking off the top even when the passenger is faced with being unable to return to work, return to family or maybe to enjoy their more expensive holiday hotel, and many other possibilities. Disaster Airline.
reviews.author: Martin

reviews.title: Avoid at all cost
reviews.text: Airline to avoid at all cost. Yesterday, afternoon flight Kilimanjaro to Dar Es Salaam: flight first delayed then cancelled. Next scheduled flight delayed. Spent 10 hrs waiting on the airport for a 1 hr flight. Today, afternoon flight Dar Es Salaam to Zanzibar. In the morning notification by email that departure time had changed. When I arrived at the airport I learned that the flight had been cancelled. I would have had plenty of opportunities to take a ferry to Zanzibar if they would have sent a notification earlier. Ground staff are totally disorganized. Lack of any competent management to coordinate. Staff kept us waiting hours for a taxi to bring us to a hotel. Flight to Zanzibar takes 20 min but now new departure time scheduled 22 hrs after the original departure time. No one can explain how to request a refund. In summary, airline to avoid at all cost, especially if you have a connecting international flight.
reviews.author: Quirijn
reviews.route: Kilimanjaro National Park - Dar es Salaam

reviews.title: met my low expectations
reviews.text: the Mwanza to Kili to Nairobi route was my only option. otherwise I would always avoid this airline. true to firm ' operational reasons' led to a delay at both ends and in all a 14 hour journey from check in o arrival. I will get the bus next time.
reviews.author: Cath S

reviews.title: delay, lost luggage and terrible communication.
reviews.text: everything bad that can happen on your trip, be sure precision air will deliver. 2 h. delay without communication, lost luggage and not the friendliest crew either. Shape up guys, its embarrassing !
reviews.author: Marita m

reviews.title: Without question, the worst airline you could possibly fly with - its name is utterly comedic!
reviews.text: We had the misfortune of flying with Precision Air (they should be forced to change their name as it is truly misleading and deceptive advertising) from Nairobi to Zanzibar, and then back to Nairobi five days later. As per procedure, we arrived two hours before our scheduled departure from Nairobi to discover that our 6.30pm flight had already been delayed by an hour. When we didn’t board as scheduled, we repeatedly asked what was happening, and at 7.30pm were told it was delayed by an hour. When the same thing occurred at 8.30pm, we began to wonder if we were ever going to depart. Aside from the significant inconvenience of the repeated delays (we had an airport transfer waiting at the other end, and had to keep ringing and emailing to apologise and try to estimate the new arrival time), it was infuriating that the announcement of a further delay was never willingly provided, but was only shared after much pestering of airline staff by the waiting passengers. The plane finally departed at 10pm - three and a half hours late, and we had been waiting at the terminal for six hours - and arrived in Zanzibar at 11.40pm. We did not reach our hotel until after midnight. One highlight was the aircraft: we were very impressed by the comfort of the ATR-72. We were also very entertained by the glorious voice of the cabin director providing the safety announcements and flight information. He was fantastic. Five days later we were to return to Nairobi on a 5.15pm flight, arriving in Nairobi at 6.55pm, where we had a night in a wonderful hotel booked so we could relax before the 20 hours of travel to get back to Australia. Precision had precisely the opposite planned for us. Checking online the day before, I discovered the flight (PW713) had been delayed to a 6pm departure. We agonised over whether to buy tickets for the 10am flight and try to get a refund on the evening flight, but decided that the likelihood of have trouble dealing with Precision for a refund was high, so we kept the evening flight. We cursed this decision many times over in the coming hours (we had plenty of hours to think about it…). Arriving at the Zanzibar airport at 4pm as required, we patiently waited for the boarding call noted on our ticket as 5.20pm. As this came and went, we noticed a number of other passengers anxiously trying to obtain information from ground staff. We joined them to see what was going on. Apparently the flight had been delayed by an hour, and would now depart at 7pm. For those with connections, this would still just work, but no later. At 6pm, the departures board suddenly showed PW713 departing at 22:10, “on time”. I approached a ground staff member and asked why it had changed, and she assured me it was a mistake and the flight was delayed only by an hour. Another flight, PW733, showed as departing at 7pm. I approached a different ground staff member and asked about the departures board times and was told there were two flights leaving at the same time, PW733 and PW713. I asked was he sure, because PW713 showed as 22:10. He gave me what could only be described as a withering look, told me to ignore the board, and walked off. As 7pm approached and we had not been called to board, the mood in the terminal was becoming frantic. Those passengers with connections were approaching any ground staff they could find and trying to find out what was happening. 7pm came and went, and an announcement was made to say the flight had been delayed another hour. One passenger went back through security and returned with a ticket for PW733 (which had still not left at 7.30pm). This created more chaos as evidently this passenger had made a case for getting on a flight that was actually going to depart, while everyone else was being told complete lies. PW733 boarded and departed. 8pm came and went. 9pm came and went. Ground staff disappeared so no one could ask them any questions. Passengers were all told completely different stories about what was going on. At
reviews.author: Wandering_about_Africa

reviews.title: Late, late, late
reviews.text: Booked 2 months ago through Goldmedal. According to itinerary we were to check in at 12.15 for a 15.25 flight. Arrived at 12.00 just to be sure and there is no such flight number and no staff. Eventually found a staff member from airport who told us to book in at 1.00 at the Precision airways desk. 1.00 told to still wait. Finally checked in about 1.30 and told the flight (pw423) was delayed for 2 hours. Still no PW 423 on departure board and no Precision staff to ask. Lots of other airways flights all going out on time. Nearly all the other flights were on 6,8,10 seater aircraft. There was a flight PW427 at 6.45 but this was also delayed. Told at about 6.00 that our original flight was now pw427 and would be departing in 10 minutes. Told again about 6.30 that we would be leaving in approx 10 mins . We finally left way gone 7.00 on a much larger plane with probably 30 + people who had arrived at various times of the afternoon. Asking around other passengers, there were at least 3 different flights on 1 aircraft.
reviews.author: 111avril

reviews.title: Incompetent to the point of being reckless
reviews.text: Despite having recently crashed one of their planes - the crew were unable to keep track of the flight manifest. They overbooked our flight and boarded more passengers than seats on the plane. Crew were instructing passengers to sit in non allocated seats. Passengers were switched between planes (forced to take alternative routes in order to ultimately get to their destination) - completely shambolic. Given the number of deaths caused by their recent crash - I would have thought the ironically named airline would appreciate the importance of maintaining a precise manifest. The disorganisation was not limited to the plane - the information screens on the gate were not labeled with the correct flight/destination details. Unfortunately there were no staff available to assist as they were busy attempting to control furious passengers. A bus was required to transport passengers between the gate and the plane. We were kept in a non-air conditioned bus for 45mins in the heat and humidity. We then found out this was a stalling tactic as the crew did not know where the captain was. When we eventually got to the plane, we sat in the plane for a further 40mins with no air conditioning. Again, the first officer was unable to start the plane without the captain being present - and no one knew where he was. The levels of customer service was aligned to their general incompetence. For example - we had one suitcase that was 2kg over weight and another 5kg under weight (I.e. overall under weight) - the staff member forced us to remove the 2kg, repack and rejoin the queue. I accept they are entitled to request this, however, this illustrates the level of service. In summary, if there’s an option for an alternative carrier - take it. If not, drive, walk or swim to your destination. If too far - then simply don’t go.
reviews.author: A R

reviews.title: Being asked to pay more than the ticket fare to change dates
reviews.text: They asked me to pay more than the ticket fare to just change dates. Customer service is zero. Wouldn’t recommend
reviews.author: Yvonne W

reviews.title: Not Allowed to Leave Aircraft
reviews.text: After having booked a flight to Zanzibar that continued on to Dar, we were under no circumstances allowed to get off the plane at our destination Zanzibar because our booking mistakenly stated the longer flight to Dar. Beware of this airline, the very quick flight from Arusha to Zanzibar is much more expensive than the longer route onwards to Dar Es Salaam - which makes no sense economically and especially from a sustainability standpoint. So we had to stay seated all the way to Dar and then catch a ferry back to our destination Zanzibar the next day. Unbelievable. Never again.
reviews.author: PrincessSalme

reviews.title: Comme ci, comme ca
reviews.text: We booked two flights with Precision Air, from Dar Es Salaam to Zanzibar and vice versa. We also paid for 2 bags of 23kg, just in case. Our first flight was OK, it is a 15 minutes flight and we got pretty quickly to Zanzibar. The plane was on time. But out flight back to Dar Es Salaam was a horror. First the flight was postponed four times, and we ended up with the last flight of the night at 23 hours. Luckily, we paid for notifications via e-mail if the flight got postponed, otherwise we would have come to the airport and stayed there for 7 hours. The airplanes are small, have no entertainment system and have very small legroom. If you choose this airline be careful when booking because of the delays and postponing of flights.
reviews.author: Dzeny

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: I booked a flight with precision air through Travelgenio agent. Had paid extra to be able to change dates. When I requested to change dates or get a refund they asked me to pay penalty which was more than the ticket itself yet I had paid extra to avoid such. Wouldn’t recommend and wouldn’t use them in the future.
reviews.author: Yvonne W

reviews.title: You get what you pay
reviews.text: Departed on time, arrived on time (okay just 16 min. of flight), bagage no problem at all, ATR plane some years on the log however okay
reviews.author: Snelling71

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: this was a reasonable flight although it wasn't a plane I'd really want to be on at midnight....a bit more legroom and comfort would be a necessity.
reviews.author: robnh61

reviews.title: Cancel my flight without notifying me
reviews.text: I booked my flight on October 12 I was told on the airport by the laggage guy that this flight was canceled on the 14th of October today is the 21st of October no email no call nothing was sent to me to let me know this information , I have two connective flight to get to my final destination .this is very much Inprofessional ps I got no assistance in find another flight out
reviews.author: LifeWith C

reviews.title: 7h delays and terrible service
reviews.text: in August 2022 I was flying from JRO airport to Zanzibar, the flight was delayed by 7 hours, the delay was increased by an hour or two. No contact with the line staff. No water, no food. The complaint was sent to precision air zero response.
reviews.author: Gregory

reviews.title: Left our baggage in Nairobi
reviews.text: As we were lifting in Nairobi, they announced in the airplane that everyone’s luggage was staying in Nairobi without giving anyone an option of staying with their luggage. Terrible customer service as they didn’t gave our bags back and don’t have an exact response yet
reviews.author: João Cardoso

reviews.title: Last minute cancelled the flight and left me stranded
reviews.text: Did the check in & immigration at Zanzibar airport for flight to Nairobi and to catch a BA flight from Nairobi. Precision Air cancelled the flight when we were at airside. This meant my onward flight got missed. Eventually at the middle of the night took us to a hotel. This was 3 days ago and I am still stranded at the hotel, they just say please wait we are sorting it. They sent us to a restaurant for food and restaurant refused to serve us they said we are not sure if we will get paid, had to beg of food. Never book a connecting flight with Precision Air, they will leave you stranded and you will have to buy a new ticket and be out of pocket.
reviews.author: MML303

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: I was really worried after reading the negative reviews on this website, however I had a very pleasant experience flying from Arusha to Zanzibar with precision air! First of all the check-in was quick and easy. The flight took off with a slight delay of just five minute and the pilot apologised. 5 minutes really isn’t much of a delay when you’re flying from Europe and it’s normally hours of delay! They also offered drinks and cakes/croissants included in the ticket price which was a pleasant surprise on such a short flight. All in all a very positive experience! Would definitely fly with them again
reviews.author: Livia D

reviews.title: Late flight, lost baggage
reviews.text: We flew Precision Air from Nairobi to Zanzibar and back. Our flight to Zanzibar was quite late. Our return flight was from Zanzibar to Nairobi, and from there to Paris on Kenya Airlines and then onto the United States with Delta. We were told our baggage was too large for the overhead compartments, but not to worry because they would be checked through all the way to the United States. That was Monday. Today is Friday and our bags are still lost.
reviews.author: leirachelle

reviews.title: very unprofessional
reviews.text: I booked 2 tickets, a day later suddenly our ticket was cancelled! This was very unclear in the emails, because it was just one email send with the word 'cancellation'. I booked tickets with another airline. When I was home I checked with the airline when I can expect my refund. They told me, that they just cancelled half my order (one of the two seats)! When is this even a thing, it was ONE booking! On top of that they also deducted administration fees because they had to wire us back our money. So in the end I received back around 30% of the amount I spend.
reviews.author: Anouk R

reviews.title: Non
reviews.text: The worst Airline ever existed in Tanzania Era. Extremely unreliable with the worst customer service and kow empathy to its clients. Not recommended.
reviews.author: Julieth L

reviews.title: Only option in some sectors
reviews.text: I have taken a flight to Mtwara. It was a good short flight. I was surprised getting a last call announcement with "gate will be closed in two minutes" even forty minutes before the departure. Skipping the ordered coffee, I ran and caught the flight which took off about fifteen minutes earlier than the schedule. The next day, the return flight didn't come to Mtwara "due to bad weather". But they re-scheduled us to a Tanzanian air Embraer flight. Though there was a delay of an hour, the staff made it OK with all the administrative hassles.
reviews.author: anwar S

reviews.title: 3 flights late or canceled
reviews.text: 3 flights late or canceled . we had to buy $200 tickets for alternatieve our selfs. 8 weeks of calling and claims to get return of our ticket purchase amount result only n ignoring the customers. They basically keep money for flights not executed. at least that's our experience of June 7th and June 13th flights ZNZ-ARK
reviews.author: Narcis M

reviews.title: Canceled flights and poor communication
reviews.text: Avoid this airline. Four flights with Precision Air within 10 days: two were delayed more than two hours, one was canceled and for the last one our luggage didn't arrive with us. In fact, most everyone who flew Nairobi to Kilimanjaro didn't get luggage. It took over an hour to be able to report the lost luggage. When we did get the luggage, we had to pay over $100 usd to get it delivered to us. The airline canceled or delayed flights with no notification so if you do fly with them, you need to actively find agents to verify your flight is still planned.
reviews.author: TerryB

reviews.title: Try another airline if you can
reviews.text: I'm sorry but this airline is probably the worst one I have flown on so far. My luggage (along with half of the other flyers on the plane) was lost on the way to Tanzania and only got to me 2 days after my arrival. I had to pay for transport of the luggage to me where I was in the Serengeti. Some people reported seeing the crew unloading their luggage after we boarded for our flight out of Kenya! No information was given as to why our luggage was missing. The people taking our lost luggage reports were nice but they gave no information - just took it in. On the flight back into Kenya we had last minute delays and flight changes that turned our 2.5 hr total in air flight into a whopping 12 hour day at the airport. If you can fly another airline I'd advise doing that until Precision Air can sort things out better.
reviews.author: Carol P

reviews.title: 3 cancelled flights in 2 weeks
reviews.text: 3 cancelled flights in 2 weeks, complete unreliability, We booked flights with other company to get there on time and requested refund for tickets of canceled flights, None of the refunds yet received 4 weeks later. We dont either have any hope that we will.
reviews.author: Narcis M

reviews.title: Horrible - Avoid if you don't want a bad experience
reviews.text: Such a super bad company, I have a super bas experience, we have missed our flight with Qatar Airways because of the delay they mad, The staff was super mean to us and they were talking to us with disrespect saying that it's not their problem but ours! wow the flight was delayed by many ours and it's our mistake. we arrived by night, nothing was offered to us and they were hidden to don't talk to us. the supervisor came and she was screaming saying that it's not percision's mistake and they have done their part of the contract! when i Was saying yes but with many hours of delay. she was saying I don't wanna hear this and litterally she was saying GO GO IT S NOT MY PROBLEM ! the staff are absolutely impolite and doesn't know what means the customer service. I had to buy a new ticket to reach out my home country, i payed more than 1 thousand Dollars, and when I sent the reclamation emails, they answred yes it's only 5 hours delay it's less than 8 hours, we can't do anything for you !
reviews.author: kenza o
reviews.route: Kilimanjaro National Park - Dar es Salaam

reviews.title: Most STRESSFUL situation - airline loses ticket and reissues it to another person. Left stranded at NBO as solo female t
reviews.text: I would NEVER ever recommend Precision Air to anyone. My agency booked me a flight with them, the airline canceled the flight and then rebooked me on an earlier one which was more expensive. I did this about one month before the flight itself which was from NBO and JRO. I triple-checked with both the airline and my agency to ensure I was on that flight. Both reassured me I was fine. When I arrived at the airport on the day of travel, the airline (despite having a ticket number and booking reference) told me they never issued me the ticket and to contact my agency. My agency then told me the ticket number I already had again and said that should allow me to check in. After so much back and forth over three hours, Precision Air did not allow me to check in and they closed the gate. I really had no idea what to do as it seemed like a conflict between a well known global agency and Precision Air. However, this seems to be a trend in the reviews and I should have taken them more seriously. It seems that flights cancel often, passengers will get rebooked, but it never formally goes through. The agents at the kiosk then told me I had to try on my own to rebook on the later flight, even if I was willing to repay for it again. Then they told me they had to leave and just left me alone at the check in kiosk. I was left stranded at NBO. I ended up booking another ticket with another airline at the regional airport. It was more straightforward. I took a cab back to the hotel I was staying at and went on to the regional airport. I'm a single female traveler who has travel a lot and is rather low-maintenance (not my first rodeo). This is the worst scenario I've ever been in, where staff actually didn't care about you and could care less that you had no where to go. I couldn't imagine what would this have been like for a younger person traveling who didn't ha e the extra cash to forfeit to literally buy another ticket with another airline on the day of. Again, please do no book with Precision Air. Everyone should be spared the lack of customer service, the lack of empathy from staff, and this situation where your ticket gets lost and you have to find your own solution to reach your destination.
reviews.author: Doris N

reviews.title: NEVER fly with them; they stole from us
reviews.text: Do NOT ever fly with this airline. We spent a lovely 10 days in Nairobi collecting treasures, and after flying Precision Air to Zanzibar, we got to our hotel to find that the airline workers had gone through our luggage and stolen not only irreplaceable souvenirs from Kenya but personal items we brought from home. I will never fly this airline again, and if you respect your belongings, you won't either.

reviews.text: Use this airline only if you don’t have another option, they kept us waiting at the airport from 6am to 3pm and we are still waiting, they don’t bother to inform you about the delays and we have to go and find the employees every time to get new information, they don’t really care about the passengers
